Why: the dev measured that `ReportView`'s bare dataset read is not old-server-only (a report grouped by a `date` dimension with no `dateGranularity` gets no `objectFilter` from the current server, so the click reaches the fallback). So item 3 sends `callerPackage` there rather than deleting the branch. The meta door already accepts `?callerPackage=` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts`), and the dataset callers of #32311 already send it; the published `MetadataClient.get` gains the one optional option so the console keeps its one meta client (auth, environment, draft-preview overlay) instead of a hand-rolled fetch. Item 1 is dropped: no `.changeset/32077-*` on `origin/main`; both notes shipped in 18.4.0.
